prTitle: fix: add the comfirmation tracking of pcp

analysis.summary: The PR introduces unconditional tracking for a specific product (PCP) on the generic order success page, which will lead to runtime errors and corrupted analytics for other order types.

bugs.title: Runtime crash risk and incorrect tracking on non-PCP orders
bugs.description: The tracking logic for 'extendedConnectedService' is executed inside a useEffect without checking if the product actually exists in the cart. The use of the non-null assertion operator (!) forces an undefined value into the product array for any non-PCP order (e.g., vehicle-only or wallbox-only orders).
bugs.risk: If the tracking library (extendDataLayer) or downstream analytics processing attempts to access properties of the product object (e.g., ID, price), the app will crash with a 'Cannot read property of undefined' error. Furthermore, it will send incorrect/empty product data for every successful order, corrupting the store's conversion analytics.

notBugs.reason: The spelling 'comfirmation' is likely a typo for 'confirmation', but without knowing the specific naming convention required by the external tracking schema, it is categorized as a low-severity data quality issue rather than a functional runtime bug.
The code destructures 'products' from a source cast 'as AppModel'. Per the rules, we do not report potential null/undefined risks when an explicit type assertion is used by the developer.
